To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the axial total conductivities of aluminum honeycomps with different cell diameter and specimen height are measured, and the thermal contact resistance and contact pressure between aluminum honeycomps and solid aluminum are investigated.

the total conductance of honeycomb sandwiched by aluminum blocks is greater in the axial orientation than in the lateral orientation, and the axial total conductances of honeycomb specimens decrease with an increase of the specimen height and/or cell diameter.
the thermal contact resistance is the major resistance in the heat conduction process of aluminum honeycomb sandwiched by two solid aluminum blocks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the thermal contact resistance measurement of aluminum honeycomps.
the thermal contact resistance and contact pressure of bolted aluminum honeycombs in both axial and lateral orientations, which are essential for the design of sandwich structures.
the thermal contact resistance and the contact pressure of the aluminum honeycombs sandwiched by aluminum blocks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the total conductance of axial aluminum honeycomb is much larger than that of lateral honeycombs.
, in general, a bolted jointed honeycomb in the axial orientation is more thermally conductive than a honeycomb in the side orientation.

the total conductance of honeycombs is determined by the thermal contact resistance at the interface between honeycombs and aluminum surfaces as well as the thermal resistance of the honeycomb material itself.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, in general, the thermal contact conductance of honeycombs increases with an increase of applied contact pressure, and the contact pressure of honeycombs can be enhanced effectively by increasing the number of bolted joints or the applied torque.
the total conductance of honeycombs is highly influenced by the specimen joint conditions.

the axial total thermal conductance is the highest when using the most number of bolts and the highest applied torque, whereas the lateral total thermal conductance would be the highest when the honeycombs are inserted between two aluminum plates with the largest contact pressure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the thermal contact resistance and conductance of honeycomb sandwiched between two aluminum blocks are significantly dependent on the honeycomb joint conditions.
the axial thermal conductance of honeycomb specimens can be substantially increased with the bolt-joined assembly.
the thermal contact resistance in the lateral orientation is much greater than in the axial direction for the honeycombs tested in this study.
